summary: PagSeguro Digital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing dividend targets and a new share repurchase program. The company expects to distribute at least R$2.0 billion in dividends during 2027-2028 (R$1.0 billion per year), subject to board discretion and market conditions. The board authorized a fourth repurchase program of up to US$150 million in Class A common shares, effective immediately with no fixed expiration. Repurchases will comply with Rule 10b-18. This capital return initiative signals confidence in cash generation; watch buyback execution pace and evolving market conditions affecting dividend sustainability.
